rubric_scores.evidence_quote: Today I'll walk you through how we work and then show you the product.
rubric_scores.why: The rep stated a plan but never asked the prospect to confirm or add to it.

rubric_scores.evidence_quote: Most teams we talk to struggle with time tracking, so let me show you how we fix that.
rubric_scores.why: The rep asked no questions about problems before pitching.
Nobody discussed what the problem costs.

rubric_scores.evidence_quote: down to a two hour month end
rubric_scores.why: The prospect stated a measurable goal with a number.
The rep never asked how the decision gets made.
The rep acknowledged answers but never summarized them.

rubric_scores.evidence_quote: helps teams like yours schedule faster
rubric_scores.why: The rep described the product in general terms.

rubric_scores.evidence_quote: We're actually cheaper than most of the market.
rubric_scores.why: The rep got defensive and argued with the objection.

rubric_scores.evidence_quote: if you sign this month I can take twenty percent off
rubric_scores.why: The rep offered a discount before the prospect pushed back at all.

rubric_scores.evidence_quote: I'll send over some info and you can let me know what you think.
rubric_scores.why: The call ended with only a promise to send information.

rapport.why: The rep opened with a specific, personal question.

tone_match.why: The rep's energy did not match the prospect's guarded mood.

price_handling.evidence_quote: if you sign this month I can take twenty percent off
price_handling.why: The rep offered a discount before the prospect pushed back at all.

objections.evidence_quote: Can you just send me some info and I'll look it over?
objections.why: The rep argued instead of asking what the prospect needed.

top_misses: Pitched before understanding the problem in the prospect's own words. See 00:25.
Never got the prospect to put a number on the cost of doing nothing.
Does not know who signs or how the decision gets made.

rewrite.original_quote: Most teams we talk to struggle with time tracking, so let me show you how we fix that.
rewrite.better_version: Before I show you anything, walk me through what happened the last time time tracking went wrong.

one_thing_to_change: Ask two follow-up questions about the problem before you show anything.
